Key updates to Microsoft Rewards
Coming soon
Starting in May 2026, we will be making updates to the Rewards program.
Here's what you need to know:
We're announcing 3 new participation levels with a range of benefits that allow you to earn points in new ways: Member, Silver, and Gold.
In order to accommodate these changes, the daily search point limit will update by level. They will update to Member (25), Silver (50), and Gold (100). There will be new opportunities to earn additional bonus points.
As we evaluate the program, we might make more changes to further the benefits of the program. There's no action required on your part.
